scripts.install-all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "python -m uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --port 8000" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "python -m uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --port 8000" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
